confirmed.failure_mode: On the second message of any chat thread, run 2's persisted event stream begins with run 1's replayed events (sequences 0..N-1, embedded event.run_id = run 1, including run 1's terminal run.completed mid-stream); the browser folds them without any run_id filter and cancels the SSE stream at the stale run.completed — the user sees the PREVIOUS answer replayed for the new question and never receives run 2's real events (sequences N..). Compounding: (a) each successive turn re-appends the entire history, so events grow O(turns^2) in ai_run_events and in model-adjacent state (observations/action_results/decision_log also concat forever); (b) starting a new run on a thread stuck in waiting_clarification/waiting_approval clobbers pending_action to null (state.ts:131, replaceable reducer) against LangGraph's pending-interrupt semantics — undefined resume behavior with no gateway guard. In-memory suites can't catch this because the checkpointer and graph are both stubbed; the prod smoke can't because it never reuses a thread and its success condition (first run.completed) is exactly the artifact the bug forges.
